# `tfctl profile unset`

The `tfctl profile unset` command unsets a profile configuration property.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile unset PROPERTY
```

## Description

The `tfctl profile unset` command unsets the specified property in your active profile, removing its value and reverting to the default behavior.

Refer to [Available properties](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile#available-properties) for a list of the properties that can be configured for each profile.

## Arguments

- `PROPERTY`: (Required) Property to be unset, such as `organization` and `hostname`.

## Examples

The following examples demonstrate how to unset profile configuration properties.

### Unset the default organization

The following example removes the default organization setting from the active profile.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile unset default_organization
```

### Unset the hostname

The following example removes the hostname setting from the active profile.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile unset hostname
```

### Unset the telemetry setting

The following example removes the telemetry setting from the active profile.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile unset telemetry
```
